contracts.name: RunStatus
contracts.description: Agent run lifecycle status: created | running | waiting_hitl | completed | failed | cancelled.

contracts.name: SchedulerResult
contracts.description: Result of a scheduled graph run: final status, channels, node history, error, output, and HITL interrupt when waiting_hitl.

contracts.name: CompiledGraph
contracts.description: Immutable compile output consumed by the scheduler: validated graph with precomputed adjacency, terminals, and entry node.

contracts.name: GraphDefinition
contracts.description: Authoring-time graph definition: nodes, edges, optional graphId/entryNodeId. Input to compileGraph.

contracts.name: HitlDecision
contracts.description: Human decision payload for HITL resume: action string, optional data, decidedAt ISO timestamp.

contracts.name: RunView
contracts.description: Run snapshot from ControlPlane.getRun: run metadata plus ordered event trace.

contracts.name: EventRow
contracts.description: A single trace event row: runId, seq, eventType (node_start/node_end/tool_call/checkpoint/hitl/run_started/run_completed/run_failed/run_cancelled), payload, createdAt.

contracts.name: StateStore
contracts.description: Persistence interface for agent-runtime: runs, node executions, checkpoints, tool calls, events, HITL interrupts. Implemented by SQLiteStateStore.

contracts.name: ToolExecutionResult
contracts.description: Output of a tool execution: toolName, input, output, status (completed/failed/timeout/cancelled/error), durationMs, attempt, idempotencyKey and error info.

contracts.name: AgentRuntime
contracts.description: agent-runtime 对外契约：graph 作者面（GraphDefinition/CompiledGraph/NodeType/RetryPolicy）、run 生命周期（RunStatus/RunMetadata/SchedulerResult/ChannelMap）、HITL（HitlDecision/HitlInterruptStatus）、持久化（StateStore/SQLiteStateStore）、可观测（EventRow/EventType）、控制面（RunView）、工具（ToolExecutionResult）。源码载体 src/contracts/agent-runtime.ts；实现 barrel packages/agent-runtime/src/index.ts。

contracts.name: ZhipuLlmProvider
contracts.description: 智谱 GLM OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions Provider：读取 .apt/agent-runtime.llm.json，POST /chat/completions。

contracts.name: LlmRuntimeConfig
contracts.description: LLM 运行时配置：baseUrl/model/apiKey；从 .apt/agent-runtime.llm.json 加载，不依赖 arch.secrets.json。

contracts.name: JobRow
contracts.description: PostgreSQL Job ledger row for walking skeleton pipeline

contracts.name: FindingRow
contracts.description: Rule hit row; one clause_id per row. Table fit expands to FindingRow[] so each SUPPORTS clause is its own grounded finding.

contracts.name: ConversationThreadRow
contracts.description: Step chat thread keyed by trace_id + step for HITL

contracts.name: JobPipeline
contracts.description: Job pipeline for SLICE-1 walking skeleton: runFixtureJob, appendChat, listAudit

contracts.name: RuleInterpreter
contracts.description: Minimal rule interpreter: required(field) and compare ISO dates; evaluate(fields, rules) → findings

contracts.name: CoreEngineStore
contracts.description: SQLite store for SLICE-1 ledger tables using generated row field names

contracts.name: ExtractionRow
contracts.description: Extraction ledger row: ocr_text + fields_json for a job

contracts.name: AuditEventRow
contracts.description: Audit event row keyed by trace_id and seq for pipeline timeline

contracts.name: DocumentRow
contracts.description: Uploaded document ledger row bound to a job

contracts.name: ProjectRow
contracts.description: Project ledger row owning jobs and spec packs

contracts.name: ConversationMessageRow
contracts.description: HITL step-chat message row under a conversation thread

contracts.name: RuleVersionRow
contracts.description: Published or draft rule version row with dsl_json and blocking

contracts.name: FixtureJobResult
contracts.description: Result of runFixtureJob: project, job, document, extraction, findings

contracts.name: AppendChatInput
contracts.description: HITL appendChat input: traceId, step, body, optional role

contracts.name: AppendChatResult
contracts.description: HITL appendChat result: thread plus persisted message

contracts.name: EvaluableRule
contracts.description: Rule subset for evaluate: version_id, dsl_json, blocking

contracts.name: EvaluatedFinding
contracts.description: Interpreter finding subset: rule_version_id, result, blocking, detail

contracts.name: ExtractionFields
contracts.description: Extraction field map passed to the rule interpreter

contracts.name: SpecPackRow
contracts.description: Spec pack empty-shell ledger row: name/version/groupKeys, no industry preload

contracts.name: TemplateRow
contracts.description: Template ledger row bound to a spec pack, optional page_image_uri

contracts.name: FieldBoxRow
contracts.description: Field box on a template page: field_key, value_type, page, x, y, w, h

contracts.name: extractByTemplate
contracts.description: Project fixture JSON onto FieldBox field_key list; missing keys become null and never throw

contracts.name: FieldBoxKey
contracts.description: FieldBox key picker used by extractByTemplate; field_key comes from FieldBoxRow

contracts.name: FieldBoxWrite
contracts.description: Writable FieldBox fields for saveFieldBoxes upsert: field_key value_type page x y w h

contracts.name: CreateSpecPackInput
contracts.description: JobPipeline input to create an empty spec pack shell (projectId, name, version)

contracts.name: CreateTemplateInput
contracts.description: JobPipeline input to create a template bound to a pack (packId, name, optional pageImageUri)

contracts.name: RunFixtureJobInput
contracts.description: runFixtureJob input: fixture kind plus optional template_id for FieldBox projection

contracts.name: RuleFixtureRow
contracts.description: Rule fixture row: pass/fail kind, payload_json, last_result for publish gate

contracts.name: RuleRow
contracts.description: Rule header row: rule_id, pack_id, title

contracts.name: PublishResult
contracts.description: Publish gate outcome: ok true with published RuleVersionRow, or ok false with reason and status unchanged

contracts.name: SaveDraftResult
contracts.description: Draft save result: new RuleRow plus RuleVersionRow with status=draft

contracts.name: SaveDraftInput
contracts.description: saveDraft input: packId, title, dsl, optional blocking

contracts.name: AddFixtureInput
contracts.description: addFixture input: versionId, kind pass|fail, payload fields

contracts.name: RuleFixtureKind
contracts.description: Rule fixture kind: pass (positive) or fail (negative)

contracts.name: RuleDsl
contracts.description: SLICE-3 DSL subset: all|any|required|exists|compare|regex|eq

contracts.name: RulePublisher
contracts.description: Configurer publish gate: saveDraft, addFixture, runFixtures, canPublish, publish

contracts.name: ProposalRow
contracts.description: Pending review proposal row: wording, status pending/confirmed/rejected, optional agent_run_id

contracts.name: ReceiptRow
contracts.description: Write-path receipt row; no receipt_id means not persisted to ledger

contracts.name: CheckWordingInput
contracts.description: Cognition-port input for checkWording: jobId, wording, optional agentRunId. Writes pending Proposal only.

contracts.name: ConfirmProposalResult
contracts.description: Result of confirmProposal: confirmed ProposalRow plus ReceiptRow with non-empty receipt_id.

contracts.name: ReviewDesk
contracts.description: Review desk: checkWording writes pending Proposal; editWording keeps pending; confirmProposal inserts Receipt and audit event_type=receipt.

contracts.name: VolumePreviewRow
contracts.description: Volume preview snapshot row: preview_id, job_id, tree_json. tree_json.submitted is always false; preview only, no Receipt.

contracts.name: VolumeDesk
contracts.description: Volume preview desk: buildPreviewTree + previewVolume snapshot. tree.submitted always false; no Receipt; groupKeys from spec pack not industry presets.

contracts.name: PreviewVolumeResult
contracts.description: previewVolume return: VolumePreviewRow plus parsed tree with submitted always false.

contracts.name: ClauseRow
contracts.description: Clause ledger row: clause_id globally unique (use ${versionId}:humanNo); heading, body, span_json, qdrant_point_id=clause_id

contracts.name: StandardLibrary
contracts.description: Ingest by layout units; searchSemantic keeps tableHits. reindexVectorsFromLedger walks ledger LayoutUnits and upserts with unit_id/file_name/chunk_kind payload; embed() is always awaited; table payload must not carry a non-empty clause_id. attachHit rejects table/annex unit ids. Never invent clause_id.

contracts.name: SearchHit
contracts.description: Retrieve/search hit: clause_id, standard_version_id, span, retrieve_path (vector|graph|exact), optional graph path edges

contracts.name: RetrieveHit
contracts.description: Provenance retrieve hit with optional ledger heading/body for detail and chat; table/annex clause_id stays null; hits table must not render body.

contracts.name: AdapterReceipt
contracts.description: Mock adapter pending-mount receipt: non-empty receipt_id + status; writes without receipt_id must fail

contracts.name: VectorPoint
contracts.description: Vector store point: id + embedding + provenance payload. Upsert must run assertVectorPayload; stores hash/return unit_id and must not backfill clause_id from point.id.

contracts.name: GraphStore
contracts.description: Graph port with upsertNode(label, id, props) so LayoutUnit is not MERGEd into :Clause. upsertEdge MERGEs by endpoint label; queryPath(kind) keeps SUPERSEDES paths free of PARENT_OF.

contracts.name: Embeddings
contracts.description: Retrieve embedding port. embed(text) returns number[] | Promise<number[]> so live HTTP embedding can be async; HashEmbeddings/FixtureEmbeddings may still return a sync 48-dim vector for CI.

contracts.name: EdgeKind
contracts.description: Graph edge kinds including PARENT_OF, BELONGS_TO, SUPPORTS so LayoutUnit can sit beside Clause without MERGE-as-Clause.

contracts.name: DemoHttpAdapter
contracts.description: HTTP adapter request/response types and session for JobPipeline demo server

contracts.name: LedgerStore
contracts.description: Async ledger wrapping SQLite tests and Postgres live; layout units and ingest pages keep provenance and index_error separate from OCR failures

contracts.name: PostgresLedger
contracts.description: Postgres LedgerStore: $n params, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, wipeLedger TRUNCATE CASCADE on t_* tables

contracts.name: SqliteLedger
contracts.description: SQLite LedgerStore wrapper: Promise.resolve around CoreEngineStore, no deasync

contracts.name: resolveEngineMode
contracts.description: Resolve memory vs live engine mode from DATABASE_URL QDRANT_URL NEO4J_URI NEO4J_PASSWORD; all empty memory, any missing throws

contracts.name: runPgMigration
contracts.description: Idempotent apply of generated Postgres DDL plus ensureRagLayoutColumns for t_clause file_name/page_* on legacy ledgers

contracts.name: liveRetrievePorts
contracts.description: Live RetrievePorts: Qdrant + Neo4j + DashScope text-embedding-v3; prequery is ZhipuPrequery; rerank is HttpReranker (dedicated HTTP /reranks, not IndependentReranker, does not share embed or llm); missing DASHSCOPE_API_KEY or Unconfigured/Fake LLM throws; never HashEmbeddings or FakePrequery fallback.

contracts.name: EngineMode
contracts.description: EngineMode union: memory or live with connection strings for postgres qdrant neo4j

contracts.name: FakePrequery
contracts.description: Deterministic prequery: table captions (\表/\见\表/\附\表) rewrite to semantic so EXACT_RE cannot steal 8.5.1 from \表 8.5.1-1.

contracts.name: BlobStore
contracts.description: Object store port for original uploads (MinIO in live, memory in tests). DocumentRow.file_uri holds s3:// URI after put.

contracts.name: OcrPort
contracts.description: OCR vendor port: recognize still returns flattened Job text; recognizeLayout returns unflattened VL markdown (pipes intact) for standard ingest.

contracts.name: StepChatBridge
contracts.description: Per-message step-chat graph: prepare, optional search_clause, llm, optional check_wording, assemble reply without writing Receipt.

contracts.name: JobStepOrchestrator
contracts.description: Job-level HITL orchestration: startRun on cognitive steps, resumeHitl on confirm-next.

contracts.name: AgentRuntimeFactory
contracts.description: Shared ControlPlane factory for StepChat and JobStepOrchestrator with persistent SQLiteStateStore.

contracts.name: DocTypeRow
contracts.description: Document type ledger row: pack_id, parent_doc_type_id, name

contracts.name: FieldDefRow
contracts.description: DocType-level field definition without coordinates; merged with template FieldBox at extraction.

contracts.name: resolveEffectiveBoxes
contracts.description: Merges ancestor FieldDefs with template FieldBoxes; box coordinates override inherited defs.

contracts.name: DocumentPipeline
contracts.description: Excel gap-fill orchestration: generate xlsx, mock upload, signature tasks, document gaps

contracts.name: resolveEffectiveExcelMappings
contracts.description: Merge FieldDef inheritance with ExcelCellMapping for fill coordinates

contracts.name: ExcelFillService
contracts.description: Deterministic Excel template fill via exceljs mappings and placeholder substitution

contracts.name: DocumentArtifactRow
contracts.description: Generated Excel document ledger row with upload receipt and trace_id

contracts.name: ExcelCellMappingRow
contracts.description: Template Excel cell to field_key mapping row

contracts.name: SignatureTaskRow
contracts.description: Pending signature task for document artifact by role

contracts.name: FieldFillRuleRow
contracts.description: DocType-level deterministic fill rule for Excel gap fill

contracts.name: CompletenessRuleRow
contracts.description: Pack-level required document type for gap scan

contracts.name: uploadDocument
contracts.description: C4 mock adapter: multipart upload Excel document to middle platform with receipt gate

contracts.name: shouldSearchClause
contracts.description: Decide whether step-chat should call read-only search_clause: false without pack; true on clause keywords or checking/check_findings/standard_lib steps.

contracts.name: MaybeAsync
contracts.description: Sync or Promise wrapper so sqlite CoreEngineStore and async LedgerStore both satisfy seed store method returns

contracts.name: PaddleOcrEnvConfig
contracts.description: Live PaddleOCR AI Studio env: access token plus model, jobUrl, pollTimeoutMs. Empty token returns null so assembly can 503 or skip health instead of FakeOcr; token must never appear in logs or Error text.

contracts.name: PaddleOcr
contracts.description: Live OcrPort for PaddleOCR AI Studio. recognize still flattens VL markdown for Job parseOcrFields; recognizeLayout returns unflattened markdown so table pipes survive standard ingest. Same submit/poll/jsonl; no DELETE.

contracts.name: flattenOcrMarkdown
contracts.description: Strip Paddle VL markdown (# headings, */_ emphasis, table pipes) so the frozen parseOcrFields regex can still extract 编号/日期A/日期B labels without changing that parser.

contracts.name: extractPdfUnicodeText
contracts.description: Decode PDF Unicode text layer via unpdf (PDF.js CMaps). Returns empty string when undecodable so the usable-layer gate can fall through to OCR. Must not use latin1 parenthesis regex.

contracts.name: hasUsablePdfTextLayer
contracts.description: True when decoded PDF text is readable copy: Han ≥ 8, or Unicode letters ≥ 40 with at least one Han. Zero-Han parenthesis/latin1 soup stays false so scanned PDFs go to OcrPort.

contracts.name: readPaddleOcrEnv
contracts.description: Read live PaddleOCR env: token required else null; optional model/jobUrl/pollTimeoutMs with defaults. Never interpolate token into logs.

contracts.name: PaddleOcrRuntimeDeps
contracts.description: Injectable fetch/now/sleep/pollIntervalMs for PaddleOcr so CI never hits aistudio or sleeps 5s.

contracts.name: ChunkKind
contracts.description: Layout unit kind for vector payload and hits: clause, table, or annex. Tables must not reuse clause_id as identity.

contracts.name: LayoutUnitRow
contracts.description: Layout unit row contract for RAG provenance tables

contracts.name: IngestPageRow
contracts.description: Per-page ingest tick status; index_error is vector upsert fail and must not be stored as ocr_error

contracts.name: LayoutEdgeRow
contracts.description: Auto PARENT_OF/BELONGS_TO/SUPPORTS edges; t_standard_edge stays human CITES/SUPERSEDES

contracts.name: IngestRunRow
contracts.description: PDF ingest batch; insertIngestRun also creates N pending pages so ticks can record index_error

contracts.name: assertVectorPayload
contracts.description: Vector payload gate: unit_id provenance, no table clause_id backfill

contracts.name: splitLayoutUnits
contracts.description: Split standard markdown into clause and GFM/VL table layout units. Reuses splitClauses for headings; table blocks keep pipe grids. Must not flatten OCR markdown.

contracts.name: extractPdfUnicodePages
contracts.description: Per-page Unicode PDF text via unpdf mergePages:false. Standard ingest must keep page boundaries; Job extractPdfUnicodeText still uses mergePages:true.

contracts.name: StandardIngestWorker
contracts.description: PDF page-tick ingest worker; OCR vs index_error split

contracts.name: renderPdfPagePng
contracts.description: Rasterize one 1-based PDF page to PNG for standard ingest OCR. Tests inject a stub via setPdfPageRaster so CI does not need @napi-rs/canvas. Live path uses unpdf renderPageAsImage. Failures throw; callers must not fall back to passing original PDF bytes to Paddle.

contracts.name: UnconfiguredLlmProvider
contracts.description: User-facing LLM fallback when .apt/agent-runtime.llm.json is missing or invalid. complete() returns Chinese 未配置 copy and never echoes the prompt, so HITL system text cannot leak into chat. Distinct from FakeLlmProvider, which remains the test echo double.

contracts.name: JobContextSnapshot
contracts.description: Read-only LLM prompt snapshot. retrieve/standard_lib omits Job file/findings and uses retrieve_hits_summary (this-turn hits or 未命中).

contracts.name: BuildJobContextOptions
contracts.description: Optional packId and RetrieveHit[] so buildJobContext can assemble pack retrieve chat without a Job.

contracts.name: StepChatInput
contracts.description: Step-chat input: Job steps use traceId; retrieve/standard_lib may send packId and current-page hits instead of listJobs()[0].

contracts.name: RetrieveHitView
contracts.description: Provenance search hit view with optional heading and body for detail panel; table/annex keep clause_id null.

contracts.name: DashScopeEmbeddings
contracts.description: Live Embeddings via DashScope compatible-mode text-embedding-v3 (dim 1024). Reads DASHSCOPE_API_KEY at construct; missing/blank key throws. Never falls back to HashEmbeddings. liveRetrievePorts injects the same instance into IndependentReranker.

contracts.name: QdrantVectorStore
contracts.description: Qdrant VectorStore for collection `clauses`. Constructor accepts optional injected `client` for tests. ensureCollection reads getCollection().config.params.vectors.size; if the collection exists and size !== dim it deleteCollection('clauses') then createCollection with Cosine size=dim. Matching size skips delete. Vectors are never truncated or padded. upsert/search call ensureCollection with the incoming vector length.

contracts.name: ZhipuPrequery
contracts.description: Production glm prequery: rewrite + intent via ChatComplete. Tests keep FakePrequery. Must not be used as rerank.
